description: Source code implementing a Bluetooth HID Service (HoG) sample for Zephyr RTOS, including GATT service definitions, report handling, and GPIO interaction for HID input simulation.

methods.name: read_info
methods.description: Reads the HID information attribute over GATT.

methods.name: read_report_map
methods.description: Reads the HID report map over GATT.

methods.name: read_report
methods.description: Reads the input report over GATT.

methods.name: input_ccc_changed
methods.description: Handles changes to the Client Characteristic Configuration for input notifications.

methods.name: write_ctrl_point
methods.description: Handles writes to the HID control point.

methods.name: hog_init
methods.description: Initializes the HID over GATT service.

methods.name: hog_button_loop
methods.description: Main loop to simulate HID input via GPIO button.
